role: Engineering applicability check of actual account Controller's frozen D4 recipe; no scientific selection

runtime.flags: -B -; inline synthetic code, no file/data writes by Python
runtime.environment: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1

recipe_checked.z: tanh(l), fixed rowwise, no scale or intercept
recipe_checked.bracket_reason: Each data-gradient magnitude is bounded by sum absolute fit-column values; penalty makes gamma endpoint derivatives at most -16 and at least +16. Beta upper derivative >=16; lower endpoint may be the constrained KKT solution. These use fit data only.
recipe_checked.curvature: Data Hessian PSD plus16I, independent of collinearity; numerical lower guard remains16-1e-10
recipe_checked.complement: eta(-l)=-eta(l), hence q(-l)=1-q(l); no monotonicity implication

implementation_pitfalls: Only generic D1 objective/solve_joint are reused; D1 pressure-specific feature keys, state, admission and predictor are not D4.
Own D4 numeric state must bind the fixed tanh transform and actual fit/check inputs; gamma0 must delegate exact immutable C7 probabilities.
Training uses unclipped stable NLL; prediction alone uses original epsilon/policy bounding with counts.
Odd complement is algebraic, not bitwise probability equality. Monotonicity is neither imposed nor claimed: eta'=1+beta+gamma*sech(l)^2 can be negative.
The beta boundary does not imply probability0.5 when gamma is nonzero. Do not add gamma sign/monotonicity constraints.
Synthetic solver success does not guarantee all real folds converge within unchanged100/200 caps; preserve any finite partial failure without fallback or tolerance relaxation.

bounds.literature: Existing local reviewed solver reuse only; no new source retrieval or literature consensus for alpha/folds/tanh recipe.
